feeds.name: Discovery Pier — Campbell River North
feeds.statusEvidence: City and destination pages identify three live Discovery Pier cameras; this north view can occasionally capture orcas near the pier.
feeds.caveat: North view includes marina and pier; marine wildlife can pass unusually close.

feeds.name: Discovery Pier — Quadra Island View
feeds.statusEvidence: Official tourism page describes the view toward northern Quadra Island and the fast-moving passage.
feeds.caveat: Broad crossing view with high vessel traffic and good horizon coverage.

feeds.name: Discovery Pier — Discovery Passage South
feeds.statusEvidence: Official tourism page calls this the best of the three for watching Discovery Passage and marine wildlife, including orcas and humpbacks.
feeds.caveat: Top-tier purpose-fit surface camera for the northern Salish Sea.

items.name: Lime Kiln Lighthouse Webcam
items.locality: Lime Kiln Point, San Juan Island

feeds.name: Lime Kiln Lighthouse Webcam
feeds.statusEvidence: Official program page identifies the live lighthouse webcam and nearshore hydrophone.
feeds.seasonality: Year-round; historically strongest whale-watching use in spring–fall
feeds.caveat: Exceptional close-to-shore bathymetry and unobstructed Haro Strait view.

feeds.name: OrcaLab Base Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: OrcaLab states its network includes three year-round and five seasonal remote cameras.
feeds.targetSpecies: Northern Resident orca; Bigg’s orca; humpback
feeds.seasonality: Northern Residents strongest July–Sep; humpbacks Apr–Oct; Bigg’s year-round
feeds.caveat: Purpose-built whale research vantage; feeds may switch to highlights at night or during signal loss.

items.name: Race Rocks Ecological Reserve
items.region: Eastern Strait of Juan de Fuca

feeds.name: Race Rocks Camera 1 — Lighthouse Tower
feeds.statusEvidence: Official page states three cameras webcast live 24 hours a day; Camera 1 is remotely controlled from the lighthouse tower.
feeds.caveat: Exceptional entrance-channel view and frequent marine-mammal context; operator warns of bandwidth limits.

feeds.name: Race Rocks Camera 5 — North Side
feeds.statusEvidence: Official page identifies the north-side camera within the three-camera live network.
feeds.caveat: Complementary angle; lens can be fouled by wildlife and salt spray.

feeds.name: Strider Rubbing Beach Surface Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: OrcaLab lists the Strider Rubbing Beach surface camera in its remote network.
feeds.caveat: Among the highest-probability whale-specific surface views in the region.

feeds.name: Strider Rubbing Beach Underwater Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: OrcaLab lists the Strider underwater camera.
feeds.caveat: Extraordinary when whales rub nearby; not a substitute for surface situational awareness.

feeds.name: New Dungeness Lighthouse — North
feeds.statusEvidence: Official page states north- and south-facing images upload every minute; search evidence was current on 2026-07-17.
feeds.caveat: North view covers a broad strait approach from a remote spit.

feeds.name: New Dungeness Lighthouse — South
feeds.statusEvidence: Official page states north- and south-facing images upload every minute.
feeds.caveat: Bay-facing complement to the higher-value north camera.

feeds.name: Hakai Quadra Bluff Webcam
feeds.statusEvidence: Official Hakai page lists Quadra Bluff among its public webcams.
feeds.caveat: High-elevation complementary view to Campbell River’s pier cameras.

feeds.name: Hakai Rock Point Webcam
feeds.statusEvidence: Official Hakai page lists Rock Point, Quadra Island.
feeds.caveat: Potentially strong water coverage; confirm exact camera bearing during onboarding.

feeds.name: Kelsey Bay Wharf — Northeast
feeds.statusEvidence: Official village page lists northeast and east views from Kelsey Bay Wharf; The Whale Trail identifies the wharf as an orca-viewing location.
feeds.caveat: Excellent channel-facing community camera at a documented land-based whale point.

feeds.name: Kelsey Bay Wharf — East
feeds.statusEvidence: Official operator page lists the east view; camera directories show current frames toward Hardwicke and Helmcken islands.
feeds.caveat: Complementary eastward coverage of the same strategic strait.

feeds.name: Skunk Bay Daylight Live Stream
feeds.statusEvidence: Operator page says the stream is available in daylight hours; Camera 1 is described as pointing NNW up Admiralty Inlet.
feeds.caveat: One of the best current strategic views in north Puget Sound.

items.name: Harling Point / Juan de Fuca View

feeds.name: Harling Point / Juan de Fuca View
feeds.statusEvidence: Current Vancouver Island webcam directory lists Harling Point as viewing Juan de Fuca.
feeds.caveat: Strategically excellent south-Victoria field of view; source stability should be confirmed.

feeds.name: Double Bluff Beach Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: Operator page identifies the Double Bluff beach camera.
feeds.seasonality: Gray whales strongest in spring; orcas year-round
feeds.caveat: Wide beach view across Admiralty Inlet with useful gray-whale context.

feeds.name: East Point Saturna WxCam
feeds.statusEvidence: NAV CANADA provides current directional weather images; The Whale Trail identifies East Point as an outstanding whale-watch site on the Fraser approach.
feeds.targetSpecies: Southern Resident orca; Bigg’s orca; humpback
feeds.caveat: High-value strategic point; confirm which direction provides the most continuous water field of view.

feeds.name: Nanaimo Harbour NAV CANADA WxCams
feeds.statusEvidence: Official page provides north, northeast and southeast current images.
feeds.caveat: Reliable multi-directional coverage; weather-camera cadence rather than continuous video.

feeds.name: Sidney Waterfront Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: Official municipal page states an east-facing waterfront/Gulf Islands image refreshed every 60 seconds.
feeds.caveat: Strong municipal, reliable water-facing view into the southern Gulf Islands.

feeds.name: Tigh-Na-Mara Georgia Strait Webcam
feeds.statusEvidence: Official resort page identifies a live oceanfront webcam.
feeds.caveat: Broad open-water view across the central Strait of Georgia.

feeds.name: Langley Whale Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: Operator page describes a live stream facing Saratoga Passage and seasonal gray-whale viewing.
feeds.seasonality: Gray whales strongest in spring; orcas possible year-round
feeds.caveat: One of the best purpose-labeled whale cams in inner Puget Sound.

feeds.name: Port Townsend Weather Webcam
feeds.statusEvidence: Browser inspection loaded a live-video element, but a current water frame could not be confirmed.
feeds.targetSpecies: Southern Resident orca; Bigg’s orca; humpback
feeds.seasonality: Year-round; SRKW use often stronger in fall
feeds.caveat: Excellent chokepoint context; confirm visible frame before launch.

feeds.name: Tacoma Narrows Bridge Live Camera
feeds.statusEvidence: Current broadcaster page identifies a live Tacoma Narrows Bridge camera.
feeds.caveat: High-value chokepoint, though the bridge—not the water—is the primary subject.

feeds.name: Bush Point Boat Launch Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: Operator page identifies the Bush Point Boat Launch camera.
feeds.caveat: Very strategic location; foreground launch angle may limit horizon coverage.

feeds.name: Beach Gardens Marina Live Feed
feeds.statusEvidence: Official marina page identifies a live feed.
feeds.caveat: Good upper-Strait geographic coverage with marina foreground.

feeds.name: Blackfin Pub Ocean Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: Official operator page labels a live ocean cam and was crawled current.
feeds.caveat: Harbor view with Strait of Georgia context.

feeds.name: French Creek Harbour Webcams
feeds.statusEvidence: Official harbour authority page lists current web cams.
feeds.caveat: Good geographic coverage; exact camera bearings should be catalogued during onboarding.

feeds.name: Nanaimo Harbour Cam — CHEK
feeds.statusEvidence: Current CHEK listing identifies a 24/7 stream from the Port Theatre rooftop.
feeds.caveat: Broad harbor view toward Protection and Newcastle islands.

feeds.name: Oak Bay Marina Live Webcam
feeds.statusEvidence: Official operator page labels a live webcam and was crawled current.
feeds.caveat: Good east-Victoria coverage; marina infrastructure may partially obscure open water.

feeds.name: Point Roberts Marina — Northwest
feeds.statusEvidence: Official marina page links multiple live camera directions.
feeds.caveat: Northwest view can cover the marina entrance and broader Strait of Georgia.

feeds.name: Point Roberts Marina — Southwest
feeds.statusEvidence: Current HDOnTap landing was indexed recently.
feeds.caveat: Complementary southwest look toward boundary waters.

feeds.name: Port Angeles Harbor Webcam
feeds.statusEvidence: Official port page links the live harbor stream.
feeds.caveat: Harbor and Ediz Hook constrain the view but the broader strait is strategically useful.

feeds.name: Port Sidney Marina Cameras
feeds.statusEvidence: Official marina camera page is current.
feeds.caveat: Potentially broader channel coverage than the inland marinas; verify exact camera bearings.

feeds.name: Sea Lion Beach Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: OrcaLab lists the Sea Lion Beach camera in its network.
feeds.caveat: Good marine-mammal context and open-water backdrop.

feeds.name: Ambleside Beach Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: Salish Sea webcam directory showed a current frame timestamped 2026-07-17 and notes daylight-only capture.
feeds.caveat: Broad urban Salish Sea view; animals may be distant.

feeds.name: Cracroft Point Underwater Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: OrcaLab lists the Cracroft Point underwater camera.
feeds.caveat: High strategic location, but underwater visibility depends on light and turbidity.

feeds.name: Fairhaven Boat Ramp
feeds.statusEvidence: Official boating-center page lists the Fairhaven Boat Ramp live view.
feeds.caveat: Useful south-Bellingham Bay coverage; nearshore foreground may dominate.

feeds.name: Fairhaven Cove Panorama
feeds.statusEvidence: Official boating-center page lists the Fairhaven Cove Panorama.
feeds.caveat: Best broad water view among the Bellingham operator’s listed cameras.

feeds.name: Jericho Sailing Centre HD Streamcam
feeds.statusEvidence: Official sailing-centre page shows a live stream over English Bay and was crawled current.
feeds.caveat: Strong open-water urban view; PTZ may change bearing.

feeds.name: KiteboardBC Jericho Beach Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: Listed as an active source by the current Salish Sea coastal webcam directory.
feeds.caveat: Useful fixed-angle complement to the sailing-centre PTZ.

feeds.name: Shilshole Bay Webcam
feeds.statusEvidence: Official page states the camera faces southwest over Puget Sound.
feeds.caveat: Broad water view; whales may be distant because of camera elevation and range.

feeds.name: White Rock East Beach Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: Salish Sea webcam directory showed a current frame timestamped 2026-07-17.
feeds.caveat: Complementary eastward shoreline view.

feeds.name: White Rock Pier Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: Salish Sea webcam directory showed a current frame timestamped 2026-07-17.
feeds.caveat: Excellent water visibility; whale density is lower than major straits.

feeds.name: Alert Bay Airstrip — Northwest
feeds.statusEvidence: Municipal current-conditions page links airstrip cameras; current webcam directories show recent NW and NE frames.
feeds.caveat: Potentially valuable elevated strait view; verify how much water appears in frame.

feeds.name: Alert Bay Airstrip — Northeast
feeds.statusEvidence: Municipal current-conditions page links airstrip cameras; current directories show recent NE frames.
feeds.caveat: Complementary directional coverage; verify water fraction and source stability.

feeds.name: Point Holmes Ramp Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: Official association page identifies a solar-powered webcam on Lazo Road.
feeds.caveat: Better open-water potential than inner Comox Harbour, but low ramp angle.

feeds.name: Possession Beach Boat Launch Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: Operator page identifies the Possession Beach Boat Launch camera.
feeds.caveat: Strategic south-Whidbey channel; limited by low launch viewpoint.

feeds.name: Bellingham Bay from Zuanich Park
feeds.statusEvidence: Official boating-center page lists the Zuanich Park view.
feeds.caveat: Good northern bay coverage; harbor infrastructure may occupy part of frame.

items.name: Juan de Fuca Cottages Dungeness Bay Cams

feeds.name: Juan de Fuca Cottages Dungeness Bay Cams
feeds.statusEvidence: Operator page states two webcams run 24/7 over Dungeness Bay.
feeds.caveat: Good bay conditions and wildlife; less direct access to the main strait corridor.

feeds.name: Post Point Buoy Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: Official boating-center page lists the Post Point Buoy camera.
feeds.caveat: Nearshore vantage with broader bay context.

feeds.name: Friday Harbor Ferry Landing Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: Browser inspection showed a broad current harbor image on the IslandCam directory.
feeds.caveat: Broad harbor water view; aggregator dependency lowers reliability.

feeds.name: Langley Marina Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: Operator page identifies the marina view.
feeds.caveat: Useful complement to the dedicated whale cam; boats may obscure the lower frame.

items.name: Port of Edmonds Marina Entrance Cam

feeds.name: Port of Edmonds Marina Entrance Cam
feeds.statusEvidence: Official port page identifies a live view of guest moorage and marina entrance.
feeds.caveat: Strategic crossing but the camera emphasizes moorage rather than open water.

items.name: West Sound from Orcas Island Yacht Club

feeds.name: West Sound from Orcas Island Yacht Club
feeds.statusEvidence: Stream listing was indexed recently and identifies a 1080p PTZ feed.
feeds.caveat: PTZ may periodically point away from open water.

items.name: Ganges Harbour Live Cam — Salt Spring Exchange

feeds.name: Ganges Harbour Live Cam — Salt Spring Exchange
feeds.statusEvidence: Current community page identifies a live Ganges Harbour camera hosted at Moby’s Pub.
feeds.caveat: Good island-community view, but protected harbor reduces whale probability.

feeds.name: Hakai Victoria Office & Labs Webcam
feeds.statusEvidence: Official Hakai page lists its Victoria Office & Labs webcam.
feeds.caveat: Busy inner-harbor context; whales are more likely outside the harbor entrance.
